ONGC Gas Leak Prompts Evacuations in Andhra Pradesh's Konaseema

A gas leak occurred at an Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) well in the Konaseema district of Andhra Pradesh, prompting the evacuation of approximately 800 people. Chief Minister Naidu ordered evacuations within a 1-km radius of the affected site. ONGC has initiated well-control operations to manage the leak.
